By Education Correspondent

A UWE Bristol graduate has secured £350,000 in investment to develop innovative AI technologydesignedto make e-scooters safer for riders and pedestrians.

Faizan Mir, 24, founded Nearhuman, a technology startup based at UWE Bristol’s Launch Spaceincubator.
